thread_text:
jules: noticed regressions in SDK 4.2.0-canary affecting streaming chunk boundaries in ap-southeast canary -> timeouts and truncated outputs. proposing staggered regional pins: SDK back to 4.1.9 for chat-stream and runtime pin for gen-heavy models in ap-southeast during 23:00 UTC window.

miko: paste sample log?

jules: ```
2026-06-12T22:40:12Z WARN stream: unexpected EOF while reading chunk
route: /v1/chat/stream
region: ap-southeast
sdk: 4.2.0-canary
```

harper: triage: streaming boundary bug only on certain proxies in ap-southeast, gen routes mostly. embeddings unaffected but eu-west clients routed through ap-southeast may see issues. recommend scoped regional pins rather than global.

jules: plan: 1) deploybot pin add --id rg-1100 --sdk sdk:4.1.9 --scope "region:ap-southeast,service:chat-stream" --duration 4h --meta "reason:stream-eof-4.2-canary" 2) deploybot pin add --id rg-1101 --runtime runtime:3.9.5 --scope "region:ap-southeast,model-group:gen-heavy" --duration 4h --meta "reason:runtime-stability-with-4.2" Monitor stream-error-rate, truncated-output-count, p95 latency. Rollback if stream-error-rate >0.4% over 10m -> rollback routing or disable canary.

deploybot: scheduled rg-1100 and rg-1101 per jules for 2026-06-12T23:00:00Z.

deploybot: executed rg-1100 at 2026-06-12T23:00:02Z — sdk pinned sdk:4.1.9 to scope:region:ap-southeast,service:chat-stream (rg-1100).

deploybot: executed rg-1101 at 2026-06-12T23:00:05Z — runtime pinned runtime:3.9.5 to scope:region:ap-southeast,model-group:gen-heavy (rg-1101).

srebot: alert rule created: metric=stream-error-rate(region=ap-southeast) >0.2% over 5m -> page @oncall-eng-sre.

miko: initial telemetry: truncated-output-count dropped but one Dedicated customer in ap-southeast saw p95 spike; paging ops-lead.

ops-lead: paged customer, investigating. If p95 >2x baseline for 30m we'll remove runtime pin and route their traffic to eu-west fallback as mitigation.

jules: after 55m runtime pin caused GC pressure on subset of nodes -> executed `deploybot rollback --id rg-1101 --target runtime:3.9.7 --force` to move that cohort to 3.9.7 and left sdk pin rg-1100 active. action=rollback-rg-1101.

deploybot: rollback action executed rollback-rg-1101 at 2026-06-13T00:00:12Z — runtime routing moved to 3.9.7 for affected cohort. rg-1101 marked rolled-back.

srebot: note logged: rg-1101 rolled back due to node GC pressure; rg-1100 sdk pin remains active.

miko: monitoring shows stream errors at baseline and p95 normalized after rollback.

jules: plan to lift sdk pin rg-1100 in 2h if stable and coordinate with SDK team for a patch. alex will add relnote: "Regional staggered pins in ap-southeast to mitigate streaming EOF during SDK 4.2.0 canary; runtime rollback for GC regression."

ops-lead: customer comms sent for affected Dedicated tenant; include mitigation and timeline.

jules: lifting rg-1100 now. `deploybot pin remove --id rg-1100` executed. rg-1100 removed.

srebot: rg-1100 lifecycle recorded: created->active->removed; rg-1101 rolled back then removed. No pagers after mitigation.

miko: relnote published and closing thread.
